data.name: Sharvansheka
data.long_meaning: The name Sharvansheka is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Sharva' meaning lord and 'Ansh' meaning form or manifestation. The name is a combination of these two words, hence it translates to 'Ruler of Gods'.
